layers.message: Add internal note field to tickets

graderOnly: The committed src/tickets.js adds an optional note (trimmed; missing, null, or blank becomes null; a non-string or more than 500 characters is rejected, which the routes return as status 400) through the existing optionalText helper. On update it changes only when the body contains the key. internalView includes it and publicView is unchanged. This matches the request and the plan.
No material findings or assessment gaps exist: npm test passes (11 tests) and the plan's recorded sanity-check output is reproducible on the committed tree.
The existing tests do not exercise the note field directly. In this EXPEDITED cycle the Developer's recorded self-checks are the evidence, and that is not a material gap.
The create and update routes were already staff-only before the cycle, so customers can neither set nor see the note.

selfChecks.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap test/tickets.test.js test/api.test.js) && echo "$out" | grep -qx '# tests 11' && echo "$out" | grep -qx '# pass 11'

node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { TicketService } from "./src/service.js"; import { createTicketRoute, getTicketRoute, updateTicketRoute } from "./src/api.js"; const s = new TicketService(); const staff = { staff: true }; assert.equal(createTicketRoute(s, staff, { title: "Printer offline", note: "  Called twice  " }).body.note, "Called twice"); assert.deepEqual(getTicketRoute(s, { staff: false }, 1).body, { id: 1, title: "Printer offline", priority: "normal", status: "open" }); assert.equal(updateTicketRoute(s, staff, 1, { status: "pending" }).body.note, "Called twice"); assert.equal(updateTicketRoute(s, staff, 1, { note: "   " }).body.note, null); assert.deepEqual(createTicketRoute(s, staff, { title: "Long", note: "x".repeat(501) }), { status: 400, body: { error: "note: must be at most 500 characters" } }); assert.deepEqual(createTicketRoute(s, staff, { title: "Bad", note: 42 }), { status: 400, body: { error: "note: must be a string" } }); assert.equal(createTicketRoute(s, staff, { title: "Max", note: "x".repeat(500) }).status, 201);'
